payload.title: Reporting agents lack basic CLI reads and consistent corpus keys
payload.description:
Found starting one Story on Machines on Machines, papyrus 5.81:
- no assignments show, so an agent cannot read an assignment's status from the CLI; no stories list either (checked on 5.72, recheck on 5.81)
- assign-research prints a next command with --corpus-key ai-ml-research, but references create-from-catalog rejects that key with Unknown --corpus-key: ai-ml-research and works only when it is omitted
- run from inside the Papyrus checkout, an installed CLI stops at papyrus-root-guard, so an agent must find a neutral folder
- papyrus editorial context --section takes a section name while stories create takes a key; check these are consistent
